# Your Mind Story

> Cognitive Behavioural Hypnotherapy (CBHT) audios that stabilise the nervous system for women recovering from avoidant relationship dynamics, created by Onye, a Clinical Cognitive-Behavioural Hypnotherapist.

Your Mind Story helps women whose nervous systems are stuck in a panic loop over an avoidant partner - whether still together, on and off, or already apart. The core premise: you can't think your way out of survival mode. Willpower and logic can't override an automatic, conditioned nervous-system response; Cognitive Behavioural Hypnotherapy reaches that automatic layer directly through a focused, relaxed state of attention.

## Key pages

- [Why This Works](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/why-this-works.html): the neuroscience behind the audios - monoideism, amygdala response, and why suggestion lands more easily when the analytical mind has stepped back.
- [How to Get Over an Avoidant Partner](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/how-to-get-over-an-avoidant.html): why avoidant breakups take longer to move past than others, and what actually helps.
- [Free Nervous System Quiz](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/quiz-landing-page.html): a 13-question assessment mapping how the avoidant pattern is showing up in your body, with a personalised result.
- [Shop](https://payhip.com/YourMindStory): the CBHT audio products.
